source_row.rationale: Fluoride helps strengthen tooth enamel and reduce the risk of dental caries (cavities) by supporting remineralization and making enamel more resistant to acid attack. Appropriate fluoride exposure — through sources such as fluoridated community water, fluoride toothpaste (in age-appropriate amounts), or supplements if recommended based on individual risk and water fluoridation status — is an important, evidence-based part of pediatric dental health promotion.
